title: Steady Payment Record and Your Home-Site Lease Cure Period
content:
**Home-Site Lease — a steady payment record lengthens the cure period**

The cure period of a nonpayment notice on a Home-Site Lease is lengthened by a steady-payer extension, in days, which counts the payments received on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months.

| Payments received on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months | Steady-payer extension |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 2 days |
| at least 6 but fewer than 12 | 1 day |
| fewer than 6 | none |

### Questions on the extension

*Which payments count?* Every payment received on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months, through any channel.

*Where do the rows divide?* At 12 payments (12 gives 2 days, 11 gives 1 day) and at 6 (6 gives 1 day, 5 gives none).

*Hypothetical.* A resident who paid each month by autopay and made one extra portal payment has 13 payments in the window: 2 days. A resident with 8 payments in the window: 1 day.
